from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDetails(BaseModel):
    """Extracted details from a single judgment document for matching against a result list."""
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., Second Instance Civil Judgment, Criminal Ruling)")
    case_number_first_instance: str | None = Field(description="The case number of the first instance court ruling")
    case_number_second_instance: str | None = Field(description="The case number of the current second instance proceeding")
    court_name_first: str | None = Field(description="Name of the first instance court")
    court_name_second: str | None = Field(description="Name of the second instance court")
    appellants: list[str] = Field(description="Names of the appellants (e.g., Defendants who appealed)")
    respondents: list[str] = Field(description="Names of the respondents (e.g., Plaintiffs/Original Defendants)")
    third_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of any third parties involved")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the dispute (e.g., Inheritance Dispute, Copyright Infringement)")
    primary_verdict_outcome: str | None = Field(description="The main ruling conclusion (e.g., Dismiss Appeal, Uphold Original Judgment, Compensation X Yuan)")
    court_fee_first_instance: str | None = Field(description="The first instance court fee amount and payer assignment")
    court_fee_second_instance: str | None = Field(description="The second instance court fee amount and payer assignment")
    specific_ruling_details: list[str] = Field(description="Specific orders, amounts, percentages, or property addresses mentioned in the ruling")
    key_parties_summary: str | None = Field(description="A short string combining key parties and outcome for quick verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[CaseDetails]
